item.title: Find a print copy of the Chicago Reader
item.description: The Reader is available free of charge at more than 1,100 Chicago area locations. Issues are dated Thursday, and distributed Wednesday morning through Thursday night of the issue date. Some locations are restocked the following Wednesday. The post Find a print copy of the <i>Chicago Reader</i> appeared first on Chicago Reader.

item.title: The Reader is reborn as a monthly magazine
item.description: In subzero January, the deep green trunk of my monstera houseplant broke clean off from its pot.
